scope: Ki Blast Super catalog — remaining base/DLC techniques

records.name: Freezing Beam
records.effect: Fires a freezing Ki beam that immobilizes the target.

records.name: Ice Field
records.effect: Creates an icy field attack that freezes opponents caught in it.

records.name: Dragon Flash Bullet
records.effect: Launches a rapid series of Ki projectiles; additional input can extend the attack.

records.name: Whirlwind Blade
records.effect: Launches a spinning blade-like Ki projectile attack.

records.name: Energy Shot
records.effect: Fires a compact Ki projectile; charge/input can increase its output.

records.name: Energy Wave Combo
records.effect: Fires a sequence of energy waves, with additional input extending the attack.

records.name: Infinity Explosion
records.effect: Creates a large sustained explosion around the user.

records.name: Burst Kamehameha
records.effect: Fires a Kamehameha variant whose additional input produces a larger multi-hit blast.

records.name: Focus Flash
records.effect: Fires a projectile followed by a rapid multi-hit Ki barrage when the initial attack connects.

reconciliation_note: Counter Burst was already present in docs/data/skills.json and was intentionally skipped. The nine other names were absent. Eis Shenron and Omega Shenron techniques are retained as cast-exclusive rather than inferred as CaC skills. Energy Shot, Energy Wave Combo, Infinity Explosion, and Burst Kamehameha retain null acquisition because the retrieved sources establish category membership but did not safely establish a current unlock route.
